item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian drones have struck Ukrainian rail infrastructure, killing civilians at a station and on a platform in Dnipro, and night attacks have left 350,000 people without power in the same city. Ukrainian investigators have concluded that Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians, while the EU has freed over 20 billion euros to potentially help Ukraine's defence. Germany and Ukraine are testing an armed ground robot for frontline deployment, and US pressure has led Ukraine to pause strikes on Russian oil refineries. Trump officials are discussing sanctions relief for a Russian fund, and a localized ceasefire in Oleshky has entered its third day. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
